description: Step 3 constraint probe (NOT a GO-gate work unit): full-tile scan, all 4 row groups, 5 columns, ~3.56M rows. Used to find the memory ceiling and time ceiling.

kernel.sql: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(redshift / 0.1) AS INTEGER) AS z_bin, COUNT(*) AS n_gal, SUM(redshift) AS z_sum, AVG(shear1) AS shear1_mean, AVG(shear2) AS shear2_mean, MIN(convergence) AS kappa_min, MAX(convergence) AS kappa_max FROM read_parquet('$RSS_DATASET_URL') WHERE redshift < 99.0 GROUP BY z_bin ORDER BY z_bin

output.canonicalization: rss-canon-v0 (rows sorted by canonical serialization; sorted JSON keys; no whitespace; doubles as fixed 6-decimal strings, -0 normalized, NaN/Infinity as strings; int64 as JSON number when |v| <= 2^53-1 else decimal string)
